friction.title: A bare JS number in a query silently matches nothing against u64 attributes
friction.tried: client.query(eq('qn', 2)) where qn was written as u64(2)
friction.expected: Numeric equality matches the stored number
friction.actual: 0 results, no error. A bare number is an i32 literal, and a type mismatch matches nothing
friction.impact: Easy to miss in application code; Chronicle always wraps numbers in u64() in the ArkivClient wrapper
friction.fix: Warn or error in the SDK when a predicate type cannot match the attribute type; document prominently

friction.title: The node filters on $createdAt, but the SDK refuses to build that predicate
friction.tried: gt('$createdAt', u64(N)) via @arkiv-network/sdk/query, then the raw string "... AND $createdAt >= u64(N)" via client.query(string)
friction.expected: Either both work or both fail (the SDK says $createdAt "carries no index")
friction.actual: The SDK throws InvalidPredicateError; the raw string query returns correct results (>= own block: 1, > own block: 0, < own block: 0)
friction.impact: Incremental sync by creation block needs an unchecked raw query string, or event logs
friction.fix: Allow $createdAt in QUERYABLE_SYSTEM_ATTRIBUTES, or document that the node supports it

friction.title: eth_getLogs rejects wide block ranges with a generic error
friction.tried: publicClient.getLogs({ address: 0x4400000000000000000000000000000000000044, event: EntityCreated, fromBlock: head-50000, toBlock: head })
friction.expected: Either results or an error naming the maximum range
friction.actual: InvalidParamsRpcError "Invalid parameters were provided to the RPC method". Largest range that worked: 10000 blocks
friction.impact: Indexer must page event logs in windows of at most the working range
friction.fix: Document the eth_getLogs range limit and return it in the error message

friction.title: A one-block lifetime is accepted but the entity is never readable
friction.expected: Either rejected as dead on arrival, or readable for one block
friction.actual: The create succeeds (gas is spent), but getEntity right after the receipt throws NoEntityFoundError
friction.impact: None for Chronicle (we use 180 days); a trap for short-lived data
friction.fix: Reject lifetimes that cannot outlive the inclusion block, or document the minimum useful lifetime

friction.title: Non-owner mutation from an unfunded wallet fails without a reason
friction.tried: patchEntity / extendEntity / deleteEntity / changeOwnership from a wallet with 0 balance on an entity it does not own
friction.expected: A NotOwner(entityKey, caller, owner) error, as the SDK reports for funded callers
friction.actual: EntityMutationError: "EntityMutationError: Transaction failed: Execution error without revert data"
friction.impact: Cannot tell "not the owner" apart from "no gas" when testing permissions
friction.fix: Decode the revert during simulation regardless of balance, or say that the caller has no funds
